title: About Us
content:
About Sofa Factory Outlet

Sofa Factory Outlet is one of Sri Lanka’s trusted furniture manufacturers, known for delivering premium quality sofas, beds, chairs, and custom made furniture at factory-direct prices. For years, we’ve helped thousands of families make their homes more comfortable, stylish, and long lasting all while offering unmatched value, craftsmanship, and customer service. At Sofa Factory Outlet, every product is handcrafted with care using high-grade materials, skilled workmanship, and modern production techniques to ensure durability, comfort, and elegance in every piece.

Who We Are

We are a dedicated team of furniture makers, designers, and industry professionals passionate about creating furniture that matches your lifestyle.Whether you’re furnishing a new home, upgrading your living room, or searching for custom-made sofas, we ensure you receive premium quality at the best possible price.

With years of experience in the furniture industry, our mission is simple:

Deliver top quality furniture that blends comfort, style, and affordability  all with fast and reliable service.

Our Mission

To provide Sri Lankans with high quality, handcrafted furniture made with comfort, durability, and modern design in mind at truly factory direct prices.

Our Vision

To become Sri Lanka’s most trusted and affordable furniture brand, offering a wide range of premium sofas, bedroom sets, and custom-made solutions that enhance every home.

WHY CHOOSE US

Premium Quality Materials

We use durable fabrics, strong wooden frames, and high-density cushioning to ensure long-lasting furniture that performs for years.

Skilled Craftsmanship

Every sofa is crafted by experienced technicians who focus on quality, comfort, and finishing.

Custom Designs Available

Choose your fabric, size, color, and layout we build furniture that suits your space.

Islandwide Free Delivery

Fast, reliable delivery to your doorstep anywhere in Sri Lanka.

Factory-Direct Prices

No middleman. No showroom markup. You receive the best possible price for premium furniture.

After-Sales Support

We stand behind every product and offer support for repairs, adjustments, and inquiries.

Crafting Comfort for Every Home

From modern sofa sets to cozy recliners, elegant dining chairs, and stylish bedroom furniture, Sofa Factory Outlet offers a full range of beautifully designed furniture suitable for any home.

Whether you’re decorating your apartment, upgrading your living room, or furnishing your new house, we are here to make your experience smooth, enjoyable, and affordable.

Let’s Make Your Home More Comfortable

Looking for the perfect sofa or custom-made furniture?

Our team is ready to help you choose the best designs to fit your style and space.

Browse Our Collection
